description: This file contains utility functions for managing Kilocode project configurations, including reading config files, normalizing project IDs, and retrieving project info from workspace or git repository.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes a project identifier, extracting repository name from URLs or returning the ID as-is.

methods.name: getKilocodeConfig
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the Kilocode configuration for a workspace, optionally using a git URL.

methods.name: getKilocodeConfigFile
methods.description: Reads the Kilocode configuration from the .kilocode/config.json file.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Gets the project ID from config file or git repository URL.

methods.name: getWorkspaceProjectId
methods.description: Gets the project ID for the current VSCode workspace, prioritizing config file then git URL.
